blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) on Thursday said it expects nearly 1.9 million passengers in its terminal from October 25, 2026 to November 4, 2026. The estimate comes as many Filipinos are expected to observe this year’s All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day (Undas). The multi-modal transport hub provides daily provincial and in-city transportation services. An influx of passengers is expected at the terminal as they visit departed loved ones in their provinces for Undas.
